assertions.name: volume_defect_route_overpredicts_by_inverse_hbar_q_sq
assertions.source: ΔVol/Vol = O(1) (1.65–3.0), not O(ℏ_q²), so B_pred=(m_e·lw/ℏ_q²)·ΔVol overpredicts binding by >50× (102–250×, ≈1/ℏ_q²). The volume-defect/mass-difference route is refuted (scope-a): binding is not a mass-scale volume defect. No fit.

description: qou-brng candidate route 1 (volume-defect / mass-difference) REFUTED (scope-a). If binding were B=(m_e·lw/ℏ_q²)·ΔVol with ΔVol=A·Vol(𝓑₃)−Vol_interface, the ℏ_q² suppression would need ΔVol/Vol~ℏ_q². Measured: ΔVol/Vol=1.65 (³H), 2.00 (³He), 3.00 (⁴He) — O(1), not O(ℏ_q²) — so B_pred=(m_e·lw/ℏ_q²)·O(1)~GeV, overpredicting binding by 102–250× (≈1/ℏ_q²). Binding is NOT a mass-scale hyperbolic-volume defect; the O(1/ℏ_q²) mass terms do not cancel to O(ℏ_q²) at the volume level. Consequence: the mass-difference/cancellation framing of Lane-4 Step 3 is refuted, and the saturated-fraction≈ℏ_q² coincidence loses its one candidate mechanism — on current evidence more likely numerology than a derived prediction. No fit; no wiring; q₀ proton-anchored.
